title: Reject incompatible repository layout bindings
description:
One fallible binding API cutover includes its mechanically migrated implementations and inventoried callers.

## Background

`IssueStore::configure_repository_layout` and `CommandExecutor::with_layout` currently bind without returning mismatch errors. The investigation inventories implementations and callers.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Layout binding returns an error before side effects when roots differ, preserving same-root refresh and recovery ordering; callers propagate errors and tests cover mismatch and same-root binding.

## Notes

See `dev/active/0f8efc37-frontends-share-core/plan.md` and its linked investigation for scope and existing consumers.

title: Share version-scoped issue capture and projections
description:
Share one issue snapshot across graph and base issue projections for each tracker version, while retaining live derived-document visibility.

## Background

The list and graph handlers each load all issues today. The list also calls `DocumentOps::with_reported_documents`, which discovers artifact paths outside the watched data directory; caching that complete response would hide artifact changes.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Concurrent list and graph requests share one captured issue snapshot and cached base projections per version; failed attempts remain retryable and stale completion cannot replace a newer generation.
- [hard] REQ-02: The list applies fresh derived-document discovery over captured issue records without another issue listing, so adding, deleting or renaming an artifact after cache warm updates its reported documents at the same tracker version.
- [hard] REQ-03: Configuration invalidation rebuilds projections with current declarations. Deterministic tests cover concurrent admission, version crossings, failure/retry and live artifact changes; tracker versions remain invalidation hints, not transaction revisions.

## Notes

Use the shared executor helper and existing lock-free repository read behavior; do not hold a writer lock across async work.

planning.outcome: Share version-scoped issue capture and projections.

terminal.worker_sized_reason: One server cache covers both projections and their concurrent admission behavior.

title: Unify issue and linked-document search
description:
Unify semantic issue and linked-document search for HTTP and the browser while preserving raw repository search as a distinct CLI capability.

## Background

`QueryOps::search_issues_with_filters` owns issue search today. HTTP currently uses ripgrep on serialized issue records; top-level `jit search` intentionally searches raw repository files and history.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The existing issue-search computation serves both `jit issue search` and HTTP semantic issue matches over ID, title and description; default issue search retains case-insensitive whole-query substring, ID prefix and filters.
- [hard] REQ-02: HTTP regex and case options apply to semantic issue fields and linked-document content, while ripgrep never reads serialized issue records for this HTTP search; an empty linked-document path list does not broaden the search.
- [hard] REQ-03: Top-level `jit search` retains its raw-file and history corpus and existing regex, glob, case, context and limit behavior; shared ripgrep machinery is reused. Documentation distinguishes the raw search capability from semantic issue and document search.
- [hard] REQ-04: Focused tests cover semantic matches, HTTP options, linked-document empty paths and preservation of raw history search.

## Notes

See `dev/active/0f8efc37-frontends-share-core/plan.md` and its linked investigation for scope and existing consumers.

terminal.worker_sized_reason: One existing issue-search computation and the HTTP adapter converge while preserving raw CLI search.
